name: Major annual festivals
tagline: The annual Peninsula festivals worth planning around — not every event with a poster.
summary: Major annual festivals is the umbrella guide for recurring Peninsula festivals that shape a town, season or visitor weekend: the events with enough local identity to deserve yearly coverage, archive updates and internal links from What’s On.
heroImageAlt: A Mornington Peninsula market and festival crowd under canvas
whatItIs:
An editorial filter, not a directory category. This page gathers the annual festivals that meet the Signature Events bar: recurring identity, recognisable Peninsula setting, enough visitor utility to support yearly updates, and enough editorial substance to link from dispatches, town guides and seasonal planning pages.

Examples include town festivals, cultural weekends, music programs, wine-country anchors and recurring coastal events. One-off community listings should remain in the dated What’s On calendar rather than being elevated here.
whoItsFor: Readers planning a trip around a season rather than a single weekend. It is especially useful for first-time visitors who want to know which events are worth booking accommodation for, and for locals who want the annual rhythm without wading through every small listing.
peninsulaCalendarContext: The Peninsula calendar can look noisy if everything is treated equally. This hub creates the opposite: a shorter hierarchy of annual moments that define a season, a town or a visitor pattern. It gives What’s On a place to point when an event deserves recurring coverage but does not yet need a full standalone guide.
gettingThere: Use the individual festival guide for exact transport and parking. As a rule, book accommodation close to the event town when a festival occupies a village centre, and allow far more time for Point Nepean Road or Main Street Mornington during high-attendance weekends.
editorialNotes: Umbrella hub for Emma brief item “major annual festivals”. Keep strict: do not let this become a generic calendar bucket.
